# VIBE Ideate

Brainstorm 2-3 AI-powered prototype concepts across different form factors. Concepts are problem-first, not technology-first — they could be web apps, conversational agents, Copilot extensions, low-code solutions, or anything that fits.

Every concept must involve AI meaningfully, work with mock data, and be feasible with Microsoft technology.

## Inputs

- ${input:engagement}: (Optional) Engagement name. Auto-detected if only one engagement exists.

## Requirements

1. Follow the VIBE Ideate agent protocol.
2. Read requirements-summary.md and PROJECT-CONTEXT.md for context.
3. Perform AI Opportunity Analysis before generating concepts.
4. Generate 2-3 diverse concepts (different form factors — at least one conversational/agentic).
5. Each concept must explain: how AI is essential, how it works with mock data, and what Microsoft tech enables it.
6. Produce comparison table, screen/interaction narrative for selected concept, Spark/Copilot Studio prompts, and engineering brief.
